findings.defect: The active state omits the unresolved Chapter 543 hook in which Sama Pyo recognizes someone passing the noodle shop and immediately wonders whether he should have obeyed Sima Gong’s orders.

findings.current: Mae Jonghak must have separated Cheongpung and me for the same reason.
findings.defect: In ordinary English, this says Mae Jonghak separated Taekyung and Cheongpung from each other, contradicting their appointment as co-masters of the same pavilion. The surrounding argument instead concerns splitting both men away from their previous, excessively powerful lineup.
findings.rationale: This clarifies the intended grouping without changing the deployment logic or the established Fire Dragon Pavilion leadership.
findings.replacement: Mae Jonghak must have split Cheongpung and me off from the others for the same reason.
findings.source: Chapter 544, Taekyung considering the deployment of powerful martial artists

summary: The packet is broadly coherent, but it drops one unresolved Chapter 543 hook from the active state, contains one continuity-confusing sentence about Taekyung and Cheongpung’s assignment, and briefly slips into dated internet slang.
